title: Norml Tasks
pitch: Turn original requests into prioritized task files, executable milestone plans and verified resume state.
problem: Thought dumps mix outcomes, ideas, decisions and work. A long index can hide the original request and make later sessions repeat or misread it.
This skill preserves exact sources, keeps one file per task, and records the checks that establish completion.

flow.d: Read owner context and every known mapped planning surface.
Capture exact wording, language, identity and later corrections.
Deduplicate, connect goals and rank bounded actions.
Use quick tasks or phases; execute only requested work.
Record evidence, rebuild index and leave one next action.

items.role: Stable task identity and required sections

items: Capture/priority does not authorize implementation, publishing or spending.
The structural helper does not verify domain acceptance or synchronize GitHub.
GitHub is optional and disabled until configured and authorized.
Cross-owner dependencies require current evidence from their actual owner.
